name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, ain't this that occult girl's place? When was the last time I saw her again? Can't even remember..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, whatever. Let's go ask her about Shiorin."
"Hello."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I see you're with a different girl today."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Heyyy, long time no see~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh...? Did you forget me already?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I remember. It's been quite a while."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Then what was that pause just now? It was getting awkward, y'know?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I'm not really used to dealing with pushy types like you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, right. You said that last time too."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...So? What brings you here today? Did you come to ask about another urban legend?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Sounds fun, but nah, not this time. You haven't seen Shiorin around, have you?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Shiorin? What kind of urban legend is that?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Nah, she ain't an urban legend. I mean the ghost who's been asking you stuff lately."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Ah, her. No, I haven't."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah~, so it's a no, huh..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Did something happen?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Well, uh... how should I put it..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Wait. Let's not dig deeper into each other's circumstances. For both our sakes."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "For both our sakes...? Eh, whatever. Explaining's a pain anyway."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I haven't seen her. But if I do, I'll let her know you're looking for her."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Right, much appreciated~"
"Thank you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Was that all?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yup, that was all."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I see. Then you should leave quickly, before the corruption gnaws at your very being."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ahh... right, I forgot. She's *that* type..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Okaaay, we're leaving now~. Bye~"
"Goodbye."
"See you again."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Now go, before..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hm? What?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "A resonance...? Could you be carrying an OOPArt?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Uh, what's with you all of a sudden...?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Did you happen to pick something up? Like... something that emits a strange power?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, right, right. You mean that thing, yeah? Y'know, that one."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Let me see it."
(Show her the mysterious object)

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Incredible... You actually found one, an out-of-place artifact..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "D'you know what this is or something?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I can't be sure of its authenticity, but... it's said to be used to perform a certain ritual."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yikes... What the heck?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "All in all, there are five of these OOPArts out there... no, four."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Come back if you manage to find all four. Then I'll tell you about the ritual."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, I don't really care that much..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Your buddy seems very interested, though."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Why're your eyes all lit up like that...? What about Shiorin? I mean, whatever, I guess..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Think of it as a side objective. It's not something you'll find even if you scour the place with bloodshot eyes."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "If you truly are chosen, then the OOPArts will come to you instead."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So they'll just gather on their own? Why?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...That's just how it is."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...You sure you're not just making this up as you go?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Now go. Before the curse eats away at your souls."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Wow, nice dodge... Eh, whatever. Let's go."
"Goodbye."
"See you again."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I'll wait, though I won't get my hopes up. Give it your best shot."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You've gathered all four...? Amazing... I never thought I'd see the day..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You're getting, like, way too hyped about this... What are these, even?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Look."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I found this here, in the parking lot."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Now... would you lend me the four you found?"
(Hand over the mysterious objects)

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Thank you. Now that the five OOPArts have been brought together..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Behold, its true form."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Uh, what're you clamming up for? You're losing me here. Go on, we're waiting."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "This is said to be a tool used for a certain ritual."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "A ritual...? Yikes, scary."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Yes, to summon a higher being."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "What exactly is this higher being, or whether it truly appears at all, I don't know. I couldn't find any definitive information."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "However... *these* do exist. Objects that exude an aura unlike any ghost or aberration... anomalous presences known as OOPArts."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You found four, and I only one. The right to possess this... belongs to you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "If you intend to perform the ritual, I'll teach you how."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Otherwise, I'd like you to hand it over. I'll add it to my collection."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "That's it? You're not gonna do it yourself?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I am bound to this place, and the ritual cannot be done here."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah... sure, okay."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "So what will you do? Perform the ritual, or hand the OOPArts over to me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? What're you looking at me for? You decide, 'cause I don't care either way."
(Hand over the OOPArts)
(Perform the ritual)

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Thank you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Ehehehe... So the day has come when all five are gathered. I'd already given up on that ever happening..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It's a shame I can't verify its authenticity, but I suppose leaving a mystery as a mystery isn't so bad."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Ehehehehehehehehe........."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "That's... a unique laugh..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I thank you for handing over the OOPArts. I'll keep an eye out for your ghost."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Now go. This is no place to linger for long."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "'Kay, thanks~. Bye~"
"Goodbye."
"See you again."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Goodbye."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Gehehehehehehehehe........."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Very well. Then it's yours now."
You received the OOPArt.

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I kinda wanna ask what we're doing about Shiorin, but eh, whatever."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So? How do we do this ritual?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Go somewhere with a clear view of the sky, a place as wide and open as possible. The time doesn't matter."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Place the OOPArt on the ground, spread your arms toward the sky, and recite the incantation."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Fear and revere the firmament."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The stars turn, an endless cycle."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Submit to the cosmic order."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The cosmos abides within the firmament."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...That is all."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Did you memorize all that? 'Cause I didn't."
"Yup."
"Again."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Fear and revere the firmament."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The stars turn, an endless cycle."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Submit to the cosmic order."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The cosmos abides within the firmament."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...How many times do I have to say it? You remember it already, don't you?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You're totally the type who keeps picking the wrong answer on purpose in video games, aren't you?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Just know that even I don't know what will happen. You have been warned. Be very careful."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "And one more thing. I'd like you to report back once you've finished the ritual. Any time is fine."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Alright, roger~"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...That is all, truly this time. Now go, the darkness is already upon you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "The... darkness? Mmkay, bye~"
"Goodbye."
"See you again."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...May fortune shine upon your journey."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, you heard her. Shiorin ain't here. Wonder where she went."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Anyway, about that ritual... You wanna get it outta the way first?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What was it again, a wide place where you can see the sky? The park might work. Y'know, the one near our usual convenience store."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But eh, it's up to you if we'll do it or not."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, no point overthinking it. Guess all we can do is keep looking."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Alright, let's gear up and hit the next spot~!"
